subject: Side-by-side findings and validation plan for Orthomed POC
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@orthomed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@orthomed.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + ask: vendor comparison and POC scope

Thanks again for the demo this morning — it was helpful to see the latency/workload examples and how Redwood handles model variants. Quick recap from our side and what we need to move forward: 

Pain points / goals we reiterated during the call:
- High tail latency during bursty clinical search queries (goal: p99 < 200ms)
- Cost predictability for monthly volumes (~100M tokens/month)
- Data isolation and audit logs for PHI workstreams (SOC2/compliance proof points required)
- Smooth inference fallbacks (we need graceful degradation during capacity spikes)

What we'd like from Redwood to evaluate internally:
1) A side-by-side comparison vs two other vendors on latency/cost/accuracy for our anonymized sample queries.
2) A short POC test plan (2 weeks) with clearly defined pass/fail criteria.
3) Answers to a few security/compliance items (SOC2 scope, retention, KMS options).

Attachments: I attached our internal RFP summary (RFP_Orthomed_v2.pdf).

Next steps we propose: 
- Redwood to send a one-page comparison matrix + POC test plan by EOD Wednesday (Jul 29).
- Confirm availability for a technical kickoff next Wed or Thu.

Thanks — happy to sync quickly if clarifications help.

--
Elena Rossi
Director, Digital Platforms
Orthomed Health
elena.rossi@orthomed.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@orthomed.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + ask: vendor comparison and POC scope

Elena — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the RFP. Short response and commitments from our side: 

Confirmed pain points (we heard):
- Tail latency during bursts (p99 target: we will run tests to show typical ranges and a tuned config to hit <200ms where possible)
- Predictable unit economics at scale (we'll provide cost bands with quantization and batching options)
- Data isolation & auditability (private deployment options + KMS/HSM notes)
- Graceful degradation via model variant routing (will include fallback plan)

What we'll deliver by Wed EOD (Jul 29):
- Side-by-side matrix comparing Redwood vs Vendor A and Vendor B across latency, cost, feature parity, and integrations (attachment: side_by_side_matrix.xlsx).
- A concise 2-week POC test plan with pass/fail criteria and required inputs from Orthomed (attachment: poc-test-plan.md).
- Security/compliance summary with SOC2 scope and suggested retention config (short doc in the matrix).

Proposed owners & timeline:
- Rishi (me): lead POC design and run initial latency/cost tests; point for engineering deliverables.
- Camila: product fit & decision-criteria alignment, will own the validation matrix and acceptance gating.
- Marissa: pricing & procurement touch (will circulate pricing bands post-matrix).

Technical kickoff windows (pick one):
- Wed Jul 28, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu Jul 29, 09:00–09:45 PT

Please let us know which works. We will also include a short test harness (sample scripts) so you can reproduce results on your end.

Attachments: side_by_side_matrix.xlsx (stub), poc-test-plan.md (stub).

Best,

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + ask: vendor comparison and POC scope

Elena / team — quick additions from product side after reviewing the RFP and Rishi's matrix draft: 

Decision criteria we recommend including explicitly in the matrix (so the POC maps directly to decision weight):
- Performance: p50/p95/p99 under your burst and steady-state patterns (weight: 30%).
- Cost: tokens per USD with recommended batching/quantization (weight: 25%).
- Security & compliance: private tenancy options, KMS/HSM, audit log granularity (weight: 20%).
- Reliability/fallthrough: measured failover time and degradation behavior (weight: 15%).
- Integrations & ops: tracing hooks, rollout tools, and model pinning (weight: 10%).

Concrete test cases to include in POC (short list):
1) 5-minute burst replay at 10x normal traffic to observe p99 and failure modes.
2) Long-tail run (6-hour mixed load) to measure token cost and KV-cache hit rates.
3) End-to-end telemetry check: tracing from request to model version with per-token cost breakdown.
4) Security smoke: verification of KMS encryption + log retention settings.

Open questions for Orthomed (we'll need before kickoff):
- Are you able to share an anonymized subset of sample queries for the burst test? (CSV preferred)
- Any mandatory SLAs we should reflect in the canary configuration?
- Procurement constraints (PO terms, 3rd-party vendor lists) to include in proposal?

I'll draft acceptance gating language for each test case and add to poc-test-plan.md. Happy to run a 30-minute pre-kickoff calibration if you want to walk through the test harness.

--
Camila Reyes
Director, Product 
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

- We can share a 1,000-row anonymized query set (CSV) by EOD today; Tom will attach.
- Kickoff: Wed Jul 28 at 11:00 PT works — please send calendar invite.
- Procurement: standard PO with 60-day payment terms; we will send vendor onboarding questionnaire after kickoff.
- Pricing bands: yes please include a 3-tier pricing view (baseline, optimized batching, and quantized) in the matrix.

Tom (cc'd) — can you attach the CSV and confirm the clinical team will be available for a one-hour review at the end of the POC week?

Looking forward to seeing the matrix and test plan.
